description.value: Legendary Noodle is a Chinese hand-pulled noodle restaurant that has operated on West Broadway in Vancouver since 1996, with noodles freshly made on-site under a registered trademark. The menu ranges from Lanzhou-style beef soup noodles and braised tendon bowls to dim sum, dumplings, and vegetable starters, making it a substantial carbohydrate stop for riders. Online ordering supports dine-in, pickup, and delivery, giving cyclists flexibility on how they fuel up.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (6 spaces) at 20m; rack (4 spaces) at 76m. Total: 10 spaces.
